phases.name: stability & foundation
phases.focus: establish scapular control and pain-free range with gradual load tolerance

phases.name: strength base
phases.focus: build rotator cuff and scapular musculature with controlled resisted exercises

phases.name: progressive loading
phases.focus: introduce higher loads with variably loaded pulling movements while maintaining form

non_negotiables: Office worker considerations: long sedentary periods, include mobility breaks

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week upper-body focus with 4 days/week; no overhead loading; pain-free range; office worker mobility breaks included"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary upper_body_focused:
    name "12-week upper-body program for subacromial impingement: stability, strength base, progressive loading with no overhead movements"
PHASES
  PHASE "stability & foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 1 - Focus: scapular control, pain-free ROM"
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction_row 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          cable_external_rotation_side_lie 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          wall_push_up_assisted 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
          thoracic_extension_sequence 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 1 - Week 1 - Lower day (to balance)"
        warmup:
          gait_brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          hip_external_rot_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 1 - Progression: keep ROM pain-free; light loading"
        warmup:
          scapular_molds 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_push_prep 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press (light) 3x12 rpe 4.5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_internal_external_rotate 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway_scapula_stretch 3m
          overhead_free_reach 2m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 1 - Week 1 - Mobility and posture"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          posture_practice 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 2 - same boundaries, add slight resistance"
        warmup:
          scapular_mobilization 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row_cace 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation_with_band 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          push_up_fisrt_angle 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 2m
          thoracic_myon 2m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 1 - Week 2 - Lower day"
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat_bodyweight 3x12 per leg rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 2 - Light loading, ROM intact"
        warmup:
          scapula_mobilization 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_floor_press 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          low_angle_row 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch_sequence 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 1 - Week 2 - Mobility and desk breaks"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          neck_relief_routine 3m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 3 - maintain pain-free ROM, progress reps"
        warmup:
          scapular_sets 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_push_body_angle 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          rotator_cuff_external 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown_assist 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway_stretch 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 1 - Week 3 - Lower day"
        warmup:
          hip_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip hinge pattern 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge_walkout 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise_slow 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 3 - Controlled loading"
        warmup:
          scapula_activation 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row_to_chest 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          landmine_press_support 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension_assist 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 1 - Week 3 - Mobility plus posture"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_relaxation 3m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 4 - consolidation and load tolerance"
        warmup:
          scapular_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row_seated 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation_band 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press (neutral) 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch_series 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 1 - Week 4 - Lower day"
        warmup:
          dynamic_leg_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 4 - Prepare for progression"
        warmup:
          scapula_activation 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row_assist 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press_light 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch_sequence 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 1 - Week 4 - Mobility and desk breaks"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          neck_relaxation 3m
  PHASE "strength base" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 2 - Week 1 - foundation for strength, no overhead"
        warmup:
          scapular_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rotator_cuff_external 4x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press (neutral grip, light) 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 2 - Week 1 - lower balance"
        warmup:
          hip_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_bridge 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 2 - Week 1 - controlled loading"
        warmup:
          scapula_activation 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 4x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 2 - Week 1 - mobility and desk breaks"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          neck_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 2 - Week 2 - progressive resistance"
        warmup:
          scapula_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown_assist 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 2 - Week 2 - lower day"
        warmup:
          hip_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 2 - Week 2 - stability and control"
        warmup:
          scapula_activation 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row_to_chest 4x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press (neutral) 4x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 2 - Week 2 - mobility"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          posture_practice 3m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 2 - Week 3 - load tolerance"
        warmup:
          scapular_movement 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch_series 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 2 - Week 3 - lower day"
        warmup:
          hip_openers 5m
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_squat 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 2 - Week 3 - pulling focus"
        warmup:
          scapula_activation 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          cable_pulldown 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation_band 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 2 - Week 3 - mobility"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          neck_relaxation 3m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 2 - Week 4 - consolidation"
        warmup:
          scapular_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 4x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 2 - Week 4 - lower day"
        warmup:
          hip_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 2 - Week 4 - push/pull balance"
        warmup:
          scapula_activation 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 4x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press (neutral) 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 2 - Week 4 - mobility and desk breaks"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          neck_stretch 2m
  PHASE "progressive loading" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 3 - Week 1 - higher loads, maintain form"
        warmup:
          scapular_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 3 - Week 1 - lower day"
        warmup:
          hip_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 3 - Week 1 - pulling emphasis"
        warmup:
          scapula_activation 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown (assist as needed) 4x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          external_rotation_band 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 3 - Week 1 - mobility and posture"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          neck_relaxation 3m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 3 - Week 2 - higher resistance"
        warmup:
          scapular_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 3 - Week 2 - balance"
        warmup:
          hip_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x12 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 3 - Week 2 - controlled pulling"
        warmup:
          scapula_activation 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown_assist 4x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation_band 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 3 - Week 2 - mobility and desk breaks"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          neck_stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 3 - Week 3 - peak tolerances without overhead"
        warmup:
          scapular_mobilization 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch_series 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 3 - Week 3 - lower day"
        warmup:
          hip_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 3 - Week 3 - pulling emphasis"
        warmup:
          scapula_activation 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown (assist as needed) 4x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 3 - Week 3 - mobility and desk breaks"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          neck_relaxation 3m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 3 - Week 4 - deload and consolidation"
        warmup:
          scapular_mobilization 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY lower training 45m "Phase 3 - Week 4 - lower deload"
        warmup:
          hip_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY upper training 60m "Phase 3 - Week 4 - finish with control"
        warmup:
          scapula_activation 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press (neutral) 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation_band 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY tech_conditioning 30m "Phase 3 - Week 4 - mobility and desk breaks"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_circuit 3 rounds
        cooldown:
          neck_stretch 2m
